title: SUMMARIZECOLUMNS with group columns from two tables keeps the combinations with a non-blank expression

source.quote: If all expressions evaluate to BLANK for a row, that row is not included in the table returned.
source.supports: the cross join of the two columns is reduced to the rows with a value

derivation: Categories: Vehicles (Bike, Scooter), Accessories (Helmet, Lock). Countries: Ann and Bob US, Cho JP, Dee FR. Vehicles US: rows 1, 7 = 200. Vehicles JP: row 5 = 200. Accessories US: rows 2, 3, 4 = 40 + 20 + 50 = 110. Accessories JP: row 6 = 30. Both FR combinations are BLANK and dropped. Total 540.
